long_biography.plain_text:
With Intelligence began as a print venture that Charles Kerr started with a school friend when both were 26. Their first publication, Offshore World, sold sponsored special reports on financial centres. Kerr then divided the broad offshore subject into specialist markets, including hedge funds and captive insurance, and developed a more subscription-led publishing model.

The business changed as Kerr acquired information products and recognised that proprietary data could do more than supply news. He recast the platform around matching private-market fund managers with prospective investors, using allocation and performance information to narrow the field of useful relationships. He also promoted employee equity as a way to build an ownership culture across the company.

uncertainties.detail: Charles Robert Kerr is the living third Baron Teviot. His father and predecessor was Charles John Kerr, the second Baron, who died in October 2023. UK Parliament formally recognised Charles Robert Kerr's claim that December. The immutable display and last-name fields conflate Teviot with the surname, so corrections are proposed while the immutable owner name is preserved in the dossier owner object.

Companies House independently confirms September 1971 but suppresses the day. The established peerage register gives 19 September 1971; the missing birth day is therefore proposed at high rather than very-high confidence. No reliable public birthplace was established.

The inherited peerage establishes identity and an advantaged social background but does not establish an inherited fortune. Kerr's direct account says the business remained with its original shareholders and was bootstrapped for more than two decades. The dossier does not infer private assets or wealth from the title.

The $1.8 billion figure is the published price for With Intelligence, not Kerr's personal proceeds. Motive Partners was the majority investor by the final sale, and no strong public source discloses Kerr's exact retained percentage or payout. No personal net-worth figure is stated or inferred.

With Intelligence began as B2B publishing and evolved into a data and analytics platform. Media & Entertainment is used for wealth creation because the original and long-running mechanism was specialist information publishing; Technology remains a plausible alternative descriptor for the company's later product base but is not used as a second classification.

Burghclere is newly established and does not publish the value or full composition of its portfolio. Its official family-office mandate and Kerr's controlling shareholding support Finance & Investments and Family office principal, without implying that every asset or investment is public.

The immutable LinkedIn URL is consistent with the exact resolved identity, With Intelligence history and current Burghclere role, so no duplicate LinkedIn proposal is made. No sufficiently verified personal Instagram, Facebook, X, YouTube, TikTok or personal website was found; the official Burghclere company website is the only new social proposal.

All personal vessel facts, politics, allegations, legal matters, controversy, sensitive private-family detail, volatile portfolio data, inferred sale proceeds and current net-worth estimates are excluded.
